official_sources.facts: GET/products/{product}, products.read. Raw identity/customer URL/status/is_available/quantity/unlimited_quantity/options/skus; source updated_at has no demonstrated offset. Field presence matters; options/skus are embedded without pagination completeness marker.

GET/products/{product}/variants, products.read. Paginated variant id/stock_quantity/related_option_values. Example omits unlimited flag and may omit parent optionids; do not default absent flags false.

GET/products/options/{option}, products.read. Exact optionid/name/type/required/visibility/values(option_id,id,name)/skus. Useful only when response belongs to selected product's explicit option set; no name/position fallback.
Official maximum per_page is60, not200. This limits page size, not total product variant count. Validate actual returned perPage; no provider total-variant maximum established.

field_presence_rules.parent: Keep explicit parent quantity, unlimited flag, status sale/out/hidden and is_available boolean as separate source observations. Quantity0 and status sale/is_available true can coexist in official example; do not infer wholeproduct soldout from parent quantity alone when variants/unlimited semantics unresolved.
field_presence_rules.variants: Canonical positive numeric variantids and bounded nonnegative stock_quantity/quantity decimal types; exact aliases must agree. Explicit unlimited_quantity/is_infinite boolean only, never bool(string). Zero with missing unlimited flag stays stock0 observed but purchasing effect unknown. Positive stock is an observation, not checkout guarantee.
field_presence_rules.options: Exact related_option_values ids may be joined only to validated option value ids owned by explicit selected product options. Missing/conflicting ids or duplicate mapping leaves labels and size coverage unproved. Human labels may be displayed as source labels, not classified as business size semantics by fuzzy name matching.
field_presence_rules.visibility: Explicit product hidden/out/is_available false blocks a readiness claim even when a variant has positive stock. Missing status/availability remains unknown. Missing/contradictory option stock visibility leaves choice purchasability unproved.
field_presence_rules.preparation: No authoritative preparation duration or delivery SLA verified in Merchant product/variant docs or local frozen fulfillment policy. preparation_time:null and readiness beyond source stock observations unproved. associated_with_order_time/choose_date_time are option controls, not invented preparation days.
field_presence_rules.financial: Native current price/cost fields are not historical costs or margin proof. Do not compute profit, ROAS or winner status in this slice.

proposed_request.route: New owner-triggered plan-scoped live selected-product stock preview, standalone exported attach initially; root finalizes path after contract review

body.category_id: one canonical numeric id in savedplan or exact savedURL resolution
body.selected_product_ids: 1..5 explicitly chosen unique canonical Salla ids, no automatic product selection

proposed_request.scope: Freshly reprove selected category membership using accepted1628 reader/pure contract; selected ids must appear in this request's verified membership observations and must not be explicitly excluded. Truncated traversal never proves a missing selected product absent. Unresolved exclusion identity blocks eligibility and remains explicit.
proposed_request.binding: Outer owner savedplan revision/fullfields + public integration/store identity/revision before/after entire operation, including fresh category reproof. No caller store/account override; exact provider customer URLs only, no URL fetch or arbitrary path.
proposed_request.reads: Existing call_salla fixed GET/store/info, GET/categories/{id} and paginated category products; for selected products only GET/products/{id}, bounded GET/products/{id}/variants, then GET/products/{id} re-read to detect changed exact relevant fields. Option-detail GET may be deferred when embedded mappings unproved rather than broad fanout.
proposed_request.reuse_boundary: Reuse accepted1628 pure checked_response/checked_page/canonical_id/customerURL validation unchanged in buildbase. Its _native allowlist intentionally excludes products; new Google-owned product wrapper can add fixed numeric product paths without modifying accepted1628 helper or shared Salla client.
proposed_request.readiness: Return parent and pervariant observations separately, perfield presence/source path and observation interval, variant pagination traversal status and explicit blocking reasons. Wholeproduct ready, global stock coverage, complete size range, preparation time and ad eligibility remain false/null unless separately proved; all paid execution authority false.
proposed_request.freshness: Each native response gets request/observation times and local source digest. Different endpoint pages are not a transactional stock snapshot. provider_revision:null, remote_snapshot_atomic:false; no source update_at assumed UTC, no historical stock-period reconstruction. Same-field before/after read detects observed changes but cannot prove no intermediate ABA or reserve inventory.

proposed_technical_bounds_not_provider_l.semantics: Proposed technical read caps to review before code; hitcaps→partial/unproved. No claims provider variant limit200, global inventory completeness or peakmemory/transport cap. Existing shared client loads JSON before decoded-size check.
